evals.prompt: Add an optional maximum-attempts parameter to an existing retry helper. The repository already has a test framework and focused test command.
evals.expected_output: Define one observable retry behavior, add and run a focused test that fails because the option is absent, implement only the required behavior, then report the focused and relevant surrounding passing checks without demanding tests per function.

evals.prompt: A parser is known to accept an empty header because the guard checks before trimming. Fix it without changing other accepted inputs.
evals.expected_output: Add a regression test for the desired rejection, observe it fail for the known behavior gap, make the narrow correction, verify accepted-input coverage, and keep unrelated parser behavior unchanged.

evals.prompt: The requested feature was already implemented before this task but has no tests. Add trustworthy coverage now.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the existing implementation, describe the work honestly as characterization or test-after rather than deleting code or fabricating a red phase, prove the test reaches the behavior when practical, and report any remaining verification limitation.
